numbered_text:
[1] We stayed at [NAME]'s place for a few days to explore Amsterdam and rest after attending a music festival. It was the perfect location, accessible to restaurants and parks nearby and also tucked away from any possible street noise. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed for a short stay. [NAME] was incredibly responsive and resolved a minor issue we had with the lock very promptly within minutes. We very much enjoyed our stay and would stay again the next time we are in town!
[2] This room is perfect for two people traveling to Amsterdam! The location is great for exploring the city and is in walking distance to everything we wanted to see. The room was also the perfect size for two people especially having two twin beds as an option. Overall, we loved staying here and thought it was great for our trip to Amsterdam.
[3] Wonderful stay! Lovely rooms, comfy beds and extra amenities like mini fridge and coffee maker with plenty of coffee. Can't beat the location- we walked to many places and stop for public transport is very close too. Since we stayed over the holiday, it did get a bit loud outside at night but there were earplugs provided. Hosts are very friendly and proactive communicators. 5 star stay!
[4] The apartment is in a very quiet and convenient location. Unfortunately, the furnishings and equipment did not fully match the photos, and the kitchen was rather sparsely equipped with some basics for cooking missing. On the positive side, the host was always available and very flexible with check-in and check-out.
[5] Lovely, convenient, clean place. We liked the loft style bed frame and the comfortable couch. It's right in the middle of the touristy area, so there was some modest, ambient, late-night noise. The steep stairs and the bedframe ladder are best for those with no mobility limitations. Host was very responsive. We would definitely return.
[6] We loved staying at [NAME]'s place in Amsterdam. The apartment is fairly centre located and within easy walking distance to all major sights in the city. It can be a bit noisy in the morning and during a day but we did not have an issue. The back garden is a huge plus. Would love to come and stay again!
[7] [NAME]'s place was perfect for our Amsterdam vacation! [NAME] especially helped us a lot with lugging our bags to the 3rd floor loft and the room was very comfortable and clean and bathroom was huge with great running hot water to make us warm for our winter trip! Windows in the loft helped get enough light in to wake us up on the cold mornings. Location next to Vondelpark was the highlight. Highly recommended!
[8] Great location and nicely managed and clean place. Communication with [NAME] was excellent. The only downside is that the apartment does not have any windows - except for the entrance door and so it is relatively hard to change air. There is an AC, but it is quite loud and does not help as much as opening windows would.
[9] We truly enjoyed our stay at [NAME]'s place. The bedding is amazing, despite the noise coming from the street - nothing a pair of earplugs can't fix, especially considering the super central location.
[10] We felt we are at a very good location, walking distance from a tram station and city centre being 10 mins away from tram. If Amsterdam is in your plan You can check this place.
[11] This apartment was clean and well stocked. It was right in the heart of things in Centraal which meant it was easy to walk out the door to something fun! It also means there are loads of people around enjoying the area too which was perfect for us but could be a bit loud if you're a lite sleeper. [NAME] was so helpful and kind! Our whole family enjoyed the we stay!
[12] Great place to stay if you are backpacking around europe to get the best price. Very friendly staff, great stay, bathrooms get quite dirty, the place only smells of marijuana and tobacco on the first floor
[13] The place is in a busy area, but its not noisy at all. The flower market, a local supermarket (AH), various suvenier shops and pastry shops are whitin arms reach. The rooms are clean and cosy, the bathroom is shared but we had no issues with that. [NAME] was a great host. He is an uplifting person with good vibes, he's happy to help with any questions.
[14] [NAME]'s boat was cosy and comfy and was great for an our stay. [NAME] was a great host and was very responsive throughout our trip. The bed and the stairs to the room were very steep so something to think about if you have mobility issues.
[15] Was disappointed due to was advertised as bed and breakfasts but no breakfasts was supplied wich was disappointed as didnt allow to pay for breakfasts in tje morning meaning i had to use money i didn't allow for
[16] Nice location, Noisy because neighbours had party till 10 am morning and we couldn't sleep. It's on the 4th floor and the stairs is too difficult and very dangerous to take the bags up to the appartments.
[17] Nice little room in a great location. The room is small with unfortunately no storage for clothes etc, apart from that it was a pleasant stay
[18] Had a great stay at this clean and spacious studio. The location was great, with sights and shops nearby. No issues communicating with the hosts and we appreciated being on the ground floor.
[19] The apartment has many issues that make the stay not pleasant, such as a leaking shower and tap, as well as a room door that is too heavy to close properly, lack of plugs in the main room, windows that are not sound proof
[20] [NAME]'s place is close to central station so it was easy to get to with our bags, yet still in the thick of the walking areas with shops and restaurants. It was pretty loud throughout the night, but overall a great place to stay. [NAME] was there to greet us and let us store our bags until the apartment was ready. She gave great local tips and recommendations.
[21] It's very far away from the city center which can be positive because it's peaceful and safe, but by public transport it took me 40 minutes to get to the center. The nights and mornings were loud inside the house so I would recommend to bring earplugs. [NAME] was nice and helped me carry my luggage upstairs which I was very grateful for. The bed is comfortable and it's a good place if you're going to Amsterdam on a budget.
[22] Great place! Happy we were able to check this Accomodation out of our bucket list! The place is exactly like in the pictures and the price is right. Small disclaimer, if you are sensitive to noise, the tram passing on the bridge is loud. Nonetheless, they provide earplugs. We would stay again!
[23] It was a pleasant stay. The location is great: quiet, next to many restaurants, canals and a park. Having two terraces, it opens a nice view any time of the day. It also has good AC.
[24] Excellent place to stay in Amsterdam, somewhat loud area but worth it for the convenient location, highly recommend.
[25] [NAME] is a wonderful host, he's very responsive and helpful. It's very unique to stay on a houseboat in such a good location and we had a blast!
[26] Although the staff were very friendly and the place was very cute, I woke up with bed bugs. I turned on the lights so that they disappear, but I could not sleep for a few hours, and got late for checkout. I am very sorry to review negative, but I was not very happy with this stay.
[27] Everything is good just that only one Aircond in the living room. So we cannot close the bedrooms door or else gonna be quite hot. May be we are from Asia and so used to Aircond room. Luckily the weather is nice during our stay.
[28] If you're looking for a quiet place away from noise this is the one. It's original and quaint. You can get to the train station in 15 minutes walk and get to Amsterdam centre in 45 minutes.
[29] The place had the most beautiful and peaceful garden to look out at, and our host was very responsive and accommodating. Highly recommend!
[30] [NAME]'s place was very neat and nice. She was very helpful in answering our questions and the check in was smooth.
[31] [NAME]'s place is a hidden gem. It's a cool, fun space on a houseboat that you won't find elsewhere. The place is quiet and away from the city noise, but close enough to go in/out of the city centre easily. [NAME] is a marvelous host and provided very clear instructions on getting to his place and how to get in, including photos, which were so helpful. Because he also lives on property, we were able to meet [NAME] and this made the place really feel like home for a few days.
[32] We stayed at [NAME]'s apartment for five nights and everything was great. He was super communicative before check in, and everything was as described. The rooftop deck is lovely, but was just a little too cold for us to use unfortunately! Very walkable to lots of shops and cafes and a tram stop right outside makes getting around Amsterdam super easy. He left plenty of coffee pods for breakfast too! Would highly recommended this to anyone looking to explore Amsterdam!
[33] The place is really good for a quick visit to Amsterdam, although a bit far from the city center, it has good public transport connection, and it's in a nice and quiet neighborhood. Something to consider is that the house has a single bathroom for everyone, so it can get pretty busy during the mornings. [NAME] was a great host!
[34] [NAME]'s place was exactly as described! The space you have is amazing. The decor adds a lovely touch to the room. [NAME] was very helpful in checking us in & communication was great🙂 Will definitely return!
[35] It's a little confusing on how to get to the house by Uber. Besides that it was perfect, only a 40 minute bus from the city, beautiful area and close to store in case you need anything!
[36] Cute, cozy, and very clean! It's within walking distance of many restaurants and attractions but isn't loud. Also the neighborhood cats were cute!
[37] Whilst the apartment was lovely and in a great location we were a little disappointed that small items were not included, at other similar Airbnb locations we have stayed there is usually a small welcome pack of tea / coffee plus toiletries in the bathroom ( shower gel / shampoo) it's a shame that these weren't included for the price being charged. We also tried to message [NAME] in 2 occasions via the app , no response received.
[38] Good location. Noise from the restaurant beneath the bedroom
[39] Lovely room, very clean and comfortable and a great location. Our only issue was that the elevator wasn't working, so dragging a large heavy suitcase up and down the narrow stairs was disappointing. Host could have been more proactive in letting us know this would be an issue and required different entry instructions. In the end we needed to message. Other than that, the bathroom is a bit smaller than the photos show, not ideal if you have longer legs! Overall would definitely recommend, though.
[40] [NAME] was a great and very responsive host - the flat is in a good location beside VondelPark, however if you are a light sleeper (like my family) the windows are single glazed and it can be noisy at night with traffic and trams passing by - worth bringing earplugs!
